clocks.rule: constant/drift/environmental terms trained only on calibration sessions
include null and synthetic signals processed by the identical pipeline

growth.rule: freeze the same external cosmological parameters and use the identical official likelihood
reproduce the collaboration baseline before scoring HOLO

sparc_primary_zero_test_tuning.rule: same baryonic inputs and independently frozen nuisances as HOLO
global acceleration scale and interpolation choice fixed on train only; no test-galaxy tuning
halo relation and scatter learned externally or on train only; evaluate the predictive distribution

sparc_secondary_nuisance_profiled.rule: all models receive the same nuisance prior budget; integrate or cross-validate nuisance parameters rather than quoting unpenalized best-fit test chi2

claim_policy: A local calculation may be reproducible yet remain in-sample, historical, or synthetic. Only a datum not used to choose the tested pipeline can support a confirmatory claim.

data_separation.clocks: group by independent acquisition session/day/site/species; no interleaved sample split and no reuse of the two historical NIST channels as test
data_separation.growth: dataset-release barrier: BOSS DR12 and inspected DESI Year 1 are development; a later untouched official release is test
data_separation.sparc: deterministic galaxy-level 70/15/15 split for a clean refit; current outcomes remain development-only because the full sample was previously used

boss_dr12.interpretation: historical external comparison already inspected; no preference and not a new holdout

nist_uv.interpretation: historical null/poor-fit summary; the local bundle redacts the observations

sparc.interpretation: descriptive reproduction of an all-data fit; never a holdout score

atomic_clocks.primary: out-of-session predictive log likelihood or predeclared matched-filter statistic with colored-noise covariance
required_reporting: trials correction if frequency, phase, or coherence time is scanned
cross-species or cross-site coherence with parameters fixed before the test session
atomic_clocks.split_unit: independent acquisition session/day/site/species, never interleaved samples

common_rules: Freeze geometry, dictionaries, model parameters, masks, nuisance priors, and the score before opening a test outcome.
Never label a score confirmatory when its observations were used to choose parameters, transforms, endpoints, cuts, or error models.
Use the same observations, masks, covariance, nuisance policy, and likelihood normalization for every compared model.
Report absolute goodness of fit and uncertainty, not only win counts or a delta relative to a weak baseline.
A failed or null holdout is preserved; it is not moved into calibration and rerun under the same prediction ID.

galaxy_rotation_curves.primary: sum of held-out Gaussian log predictive densities, normalized per retained velocity datum
required_inputs: independently fixed or hierarchically predicted distance, inclination, and mass-to-light nuisances
secondary: median per-galaxy chi2 per retained datum
galaxy-level win fraction with a galaxy-cluster bootstrap interval
residual calibration by radius and surface-brightness strata

growth_rsd.primary: generalized chi2 r^T C^-1 r or the official full-shape log likelihood
growth_rsd.primary_contrast: delta chi2 = chi2_HOLO - chi2_LCDM on the same frozen data vector and nuisance treatment
required_reporting: scale cuts, tracer selection, nuisance count, and any look-elsewhere correction

predictions.next_test: refit five parameters on train only, use validation once, then freeze; treat the SPARC test group as honest development estimation and reserve a new external galaxy catalogue for confirmation
predictions.observable: point-level circular velocity conditioned only on baryonic inputs and five frozen global readout parameters

audit_result.interpretation: historical external comparison already inspected; no preference and not a new holdout

predictions.next_test: freeze a 4D growth prediction and score an untouched later survey release with its official likelihood

legacy_dictionary_signature.classification: edge-of-domain composite-dictionary signature; not a derived 4D prediction

predictions.next_test: ingest the official frozen likelihood without changing the prediction curve, target window, cuts, or score
predictions.observable: f_sigma8 or full-shape growth likelihood in predeclared bins intersecting 0.90 <= z_eff <= 1.05
predictions.release_holdout_rule: BOSS DR12 and DESI Year 1 are development context; the first official later DESI growth likelihood not used to alter this protocol is the test release

audit_result.interpretation: historical null/poor-fit summary; the local bundle redacts the observations

predictions.next_test: use a new acquisition session and dissimilar transition/site after deriving a dimensional, non-universal clock coupling
a predeclared differential line in independent clock sessions would falsify the minimal null or require an explicitly new interaction model
predictions.observable: differential frequency ratio of co-located dissimilar atomic transitions
predictions.theory_statement: the current universal metric-only completion has no direct classical Maxwell vertex and no leading universal differential clock-ratio signal

clocks.algorithm: SHA256(salt + '|' + session_id) mapped to [0,1): calibration <0.50, validation <0.75, otherwise test
clocks.historical_nist_sessions: development-only regardless of hash bucket because outcomes were already inspected
clocks.unit: complete independent acquisition session/day/site/species; all channels from one session stay together

growth.test: chronologically first later official growth likelihood not used to change this protocol
growth.unit: complete covariance-coupled survey likelihood, never individual correlated redshift rows

readiness.bottom_line: No local observational arm currently qualifies as a clean confirmatory holdout.
